newsitem.title: MACAU: Macau arrivals up 2.4 pct to 4.66 mln in Jan-July.
newsitem.headline: Macau arrivals up 2.4 pct to 4.66 mln in Jan-July.

text.p: Arrivals to Portuguese-administered Macau grew 2.4 percent year-on-year in the first seven months of 1996 to 4.66 million, the Macau Statistics and Census Department said on Tuesday.

Average occupancy rate at Macau's 41 hotels, two Portuguese-style inns and 62 guesthouses rose 2.6 percentage points to 58.1 percent. But the number of rooms decreased 0.03 percent year-on-year to total 7,722 at the end of July.
Among the main tourist attractions in Macau, on the coast of southern China near Hong Kong, are its nine casinos and other betting venues including a greyhound canidrome.
Franchised gaming businesses and tourism are among Macau's major breadwinners.
